reference_sql:
WITH base AS (
  -- one row per account with MRR in September 2024
  SELECT s.account_id, a.segment, s.mrr_eur AS start_mrr, COALESCE(e.mrr_eur, 0) AS end_mrr
  FROM mrr_monthly AS s
  JOIN accounts AS a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly AS e
    ON e.account_id = s.account_id AND e.month = DATE '2025-09-01'
  WHERE s.month = DATE '2024-09-01'
),
totals AS (
  -- one row per segment, then one row for all segments together
  SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS start_accounts, SUM(start_mrr) AS start_mrr, SUM(end_mrr) AS end_mrr,
         SUM(CASE WHEN end_mrr < start_mrr THEN end_mrr ELSE start_mrr END) AS kept_mrr
  FROM base
  GROUP BY segment
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Total', COUNT(*), SUM(start_mrr), SUM(end_mrr), SUM(CASE WHEN end_mrr < start_mrr THEN end_mrr ELSE start_mrr END)
  FROM base
)
SELECT segment, start_accounts, ROUND(start_mrr, 2) AS start_mrr, ROUND(end_mrr, 2) AS end_mrr,
       ROUND(100.0 * end_mrr / start_mrr, 1) AS nrr_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * kept_mrr / start_mrr, 1) AS grr_pct
FROM totals
ORDER BY segment

solver.query:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT a.segment, s.mrr_eur AS start_mrr, COALESCE(e.mrr_eur, 0) AS end_mrr
  FROM mrr_monthly s
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly e ON e.account_id = s.account_id AND e.month = DATE '2025-09-01'
  WHERE s.month = DATE '2024-09-01'
), u AS (
  SELECT segment, start_mrr, end_mrr FROM b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Total', start_mrr, end_mrr FROM b
)
SELECT segment,
       COUNT(*) AS start_accounts,
       ROUND(SUM(start_mrr), 2) AS start_mrr,
       ROUND(SUM(end_mrr), 2) AS end_mrr,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(end_mrr) / SUM(start_mrr), 1) AS nrr_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(LEAST(end_mrr, start_mrr)) / SUM(start_mrr), 1) AS grr_pct
FROM u
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment
